title: European Master in Sustainable Systems Engineering
level: Bachelor's graduates in engineering or technical fields
about: The European Master in Sustainable Systems Engineering (EMSSE), a two-year Erasmus Mundus Joint Master, takes applications for its 2027-2029 intake through application.emsse.eu from 15 November 2026 to 15 February 2027 (23:59 Paris time); interviews run 18 to 20 March 2027.
requirements: Bachelor's-level degree (180 ECTS) in a related engineering or technical field
Final-year students may apply if they expect to graduate by 31 July of the application year
card_alt: Card for the European Master in Sustainable Systems Engineering offered by EMSSE (Erasmus Mundus Joint Master), applications due 15 Feb 2027. The photo is a generic default image of a city skyline over a river at sunset and does not show a programme location.
